dedupe_keys.name: flarer lake forecast and data assimilation workflow

description: FLAREr is an R workflow for the Forecasting Lake and Reservoir Ecosystems system. Its developers prepare General Lake Model input and configuration, assimilate observations to update starting states and parameters, and process and archive 1- to 35-day forecasts of water temperature and quality at multiple depths. Users provide a lake configuration, weather forecasts and near-real-time water observations; outputs are probabilistic forecast series and plots for that lake. Geography and vertical resolution follow the lake model, with forecast horizons bounded by the configured run. GPL-3.0 source, guide and examples are freely available on GitHub. The README documents applications at reservoirs and lakes in the United States and Ireland, but these are site-specific evaluations, not guaranteed skill elsewhere. A limitation is that FLARE v4 requires a GLM-AED v4 alpha build with NetCDF restart support, and the documented binary path does not yet support Windows directly. This workflow serves reservoir-operation and water-quality warning simulations. The catalogue's data-freshwater-watch-citizen-science-water-quality is a separate possible observation source, not a tested FLARE feed. No forecast was run or data downloaded.
